 TNN Updated: Nov 11, 2026, 16:14 IST The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the examination schedule for the Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2027. Candidates who have registered for the examination can check the detailed schedule on the official UPSC website.
 According to the timetable, the Preliminary Examination will be conducted on January 31, 2027, while the Main Examination is scheduled for June 18, 2027.
 The examination is conducted to recruit eligible candidates to Group A and Group B engineering posts across various departments of the Central government. The selection process comprises three stages: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and Personality Test.
 Prelims 
 The UPSC ESE Preliminary Examination will be held on January 31, 2027. It is the first stage of the selection process, and candidates qualifying in the examination will be eligible to appear for the Mains. The Preliminary Examination comprises two papers. General Studies and Engineering Aptitude carries 200 marks, while the discipline-specific paper carries 300 marks, taking the total to 500 marks. The examination will cover four engineering disciplines: Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering.
 Admit Card and Result 
 UPSC is expected to release the ESE Preliminary Examination admit cards in January 2027, ahead of the examination. The commission has not yet announced the exact admit card release date. The Preliminary Examination result is expected in March 2027. However, the confirmed result declaration date is yet to be announced.
 How to download UPSC ESE 2027 examination schedule
 Candidates can follow these steps to access the examination timetable:
 Visit the official UPSC website at upsc.gov.in .
 Navigate to the 'What's New' or 'Examination Notices' section.
 Find the notification for the Engineering Services Examination 2027.
 Click on the relevant notification link.
 The examination schedule will appear on the screen in PDF format.
 Download the PDF and save it for future reference
 Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official website for updates regarding admit cards, results, and further examination-related instructions.
